subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Sellers knew where to place things.”?
options: Customers knew which stands opened earliest.
A small bakery opened near Mark's school.
Tom's uncle opened a small noodle shop.
Shop owners near stations saw more customers.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Sellers knew where to place things. Customers knew which stands opened earliest.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A small bakery opened near Mark's school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Tom's uncle opened a small noodle shop.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Shop owners near stations saw more customers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Sellers knew where to place things. Customers knew which stands opened earliest.」，答案為「Customers knew which stands opened earliest.」。
